The printed practical header reads '2026/20267'; corrected to 2026/2027.

Pharmaceutical Organic Chemistry-I (02-06-05-101) sections are governed by a NEW departmental attendance division (issued ~Nov 2026) with strict 'attend only in your slot' enforcement. Five fixed dated Sunday sessions encoded in practicals.json: 8/11 → 1A(1–3), 2A(3–5), 3A(5–7); 15/11 → 1B(1–3), 2B(3–5). Location reused from the prior weekly sheet (New Building, 4th floor, room null — no room name is printed). The standing weekly Organic slot is windowed so the dated division supersedes it without overlap: groups 1&2 skip both 8/11 and 15/11; group 3 skips only 8/11 and KEEPS its weekly 17:00-18:50 active on 15/11 because the division omits 3B that day (flagged ORGANIC_I_3B_SOURCE_GAP, not encoded as free). Anomalies flagged not normalized: 2A includes outlier seat 2615177; 2B includes cross-prefix seat 2635001 plus an open 'external/unnumbered students' clause.

Drug Design (02-06-05305) ChemSketch cycle is encoded as four dated Wednesday practical events (2026-09-30, 10-07, 10-14, 10-21), each with six time slots tagged by group + A/B subdivision (New Building, 4th floor Drug Design / Simulation Lab). Quiz-1 is a dated Wednesday examination (2026-11-18, Old Building 2nd floor Pharmaceutical Chemistry Lab) with six 30-minute batch slots. These replace the previous 'referenced but not materialized' state so the Compare tool reports these groups BUSY at the printed times instead of Free.

The source prints seat-range batches inside each subdivision (e.g. 1A 2415001-2415010 then 2415011-2415020). At group/subdivision granularity the whole sub-group is busy whenever any of its batches meets, so the dated events are tagged by subdivision only; the exact seat ranges are recorded in each event's sourceReview for a future per-student view. The 2026-10-21 12:00-13:00 3B slot also lists two non-2415 seats (2435001, 2435002) noted but not encoded as a 2415 session.

The Wet Lab timetable prints only 'Week 1 = Group A / Week 2 = Group B' per section (9-11, 11-1, 1-3) with no calendar dates and two rooms (Pharmaceutical Chemistry Lab Old 2nd floor + Organic Chemistry Lab New 4th floor). With no anchor date it cannot be placed on the grid, so it is intentionally NOT materialized (DATE_UNCONFIRMED); a ChemSketch Wednesday already covers the same 9-11 window for the tested subdivision, so the slot finder is not silently wrong there.

The Drug Information (02-06-09305) tutorial sheet gives dated weeks and A/B alternation and a mid-term (1/11) plus final practical exams (6/12 A, 13/12 B) but NO clock times. Untimed sessions cannot occupy a time grid, so they are not materialized as timed events (TIME_UNCONFIRMED); the 1/11 mid-term falls inside the college blackout week regardless. Flagged rather than invented.

Department instruction: every lecture and practical section in this semester runs every week for both groups; there are no alternating A/B weeks. The only deviations are the two Phytochemistry-I examination Thursdays (2026-11-19 Group A, 2026-11-26 Group B), represented by dated examination events; the weekly practical's validity windows simply skip those two dates, so no cancel exceptions exist.

The printed practical sheet lists Wednesday Pharmaceutical Microbiology as 3:00-4:50 Group 2 / 5:00-6:50 Group 1. The department switched the two groups without reprinting the schedule, so the dataset stores the corrected order (Group 1 3:00-4:50, Group 2 5:00-6:50).

Phytochemistry-I is a weekly Thursday practical for both groups, expressed as two validity windows that exclude the two examination Thursdays (ends 2026-11-18, resumes 2026-11-27). The mid-term blackout separately suppresses 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-05. No cancel exceptions are used, so nothing is left as a cancelled remnant.
